mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_ID, USER_ID, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, REPORT_STATUS FROM report WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'PENDING' OR REPORT_STATUS = 'IN_REVIEW'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report(USER_ID, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID) VALUES(#{userId}, NOW(), #{reportContent}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
